detail.longDescription: I've been writing about AI since before most people knew what it stood for, so a question as simple as "What is ChatGPT?" should be a softball. But as OpenAI has kept pushing ChatGPT forward with new models and features, it's gotten surprisingly hard to answer. ChatGPT isn't just a chatbot anymore. It's an agent harness, a coding agent, an always-on personal assistant, and a bunch of other terms that have all gotten a bit fuzzy. Here, I'll do my best to break it all down for you.
